Description: ( Under propose new solar system)  Tear off all existing roofing down to the wood decking and haul away. Remove all protruding fasteners and sweep roof deck clean. Inspect the roofing decking for any dry rot. If present we shall advise cost to replace on a time and materials basis only. Install new plumbing collars and heater vents. Nail over the entire roof area, 1-layer of 30 lb asphalt saturated felt. The felt is to be installed starting at the lower edge of the roof and overlapping each other at 2’’ on the upper edge 6’’ on the ends. Install Gaf timberline 30 year Class “A” fire rated shingles according to the manufacturers specifications. All shingles shall be installed with nails (no staples). We shall issue manufacturer’s written warranty upon completion and payment on the roof. COLOR: to match existing roof color. Install new starter and bleeder strips around the perimeter of the roof. Install new hip and ridge shingles at all required locations.
